ANON_KEY.description: Public anon JWT — references shared ANON_KEY.

SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.description: Server-side full-access key — references shared SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.

PGRST_JWT_SECRET.description: HS256 secret for JWT verification — references shared JWT_SECRET.

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection for storage API — uses private networking.

FILE_SIZE_LIMIT.description: Maximum file upload size in bytes (50MB).

GLOBAL_S3_BUCKET.description: Default S3 bucket name for storage.

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: S3 access key — references MinIO root user.

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: S3 secret key — references MinIO root password.

AWS_S3_ENDPOINT.description: S3 endpoint URL — uses MinIO private domain.

AWS_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: Force S3 path-style addressing (required for MinIO).

ENABLE_IMAGE_TRANSFORMATION.description: Disable image transformation to save RAM.
